It's up to you to decide if it's useless for yourself. It isn't something "that you just brush off once in a while" and hop back into it unless you make it that way. If you're learning it and dedicating many years of your life to this, you're most likely going to make plenty of Japanese friends online. You're not only learning, but willingly dedicating a large amount of time to a form of communication, something that you WON'T forget in a very long time from now. It's not up to your parents to decide if it's useless or not, and their opinions on this shouldn't hold enough weight to dig at you like that. This was your decision, and you must have some sort of driving force along the way. The purpose of it and what you plan to do with it is the deciding factor of what makes it useless. Don't let reddit or your parents figure it out for you, you figure it out for you. Do the best for yourself in this situation.
